chunks: And it was narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim that he was asked about a man leading two men in prayer; he said:
"He should stand ahead of them and not stand between them."
And regarding two men praying in congregation, he said: "Yes, he should place him on his right."

key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: leads in salat as the Imam
key_terms.يَتَقَدَّمُهُمَا: stands ahead of the two worshippers

ai.seo_question: How should two or three men stand in congregational salat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the arrangement of worshippers in congregational salat. When one man leads two others, he stands in front of them, and when only two men pray together, the follower stands on the Imam's right.
